references.text: The act of tearing one's clothes was an expression of grief or shock, also mentioned in connection with other significant events in the Tanach.
Tearing garments was a common custom in Jewish tradition to show deep sorrow or disgust, as reflected in the high priest's reaction.
Luke also includes a similar scene where Jesus is accused of blasphemy, showing consistency across the Gospel accounts.
John also mentions accusations of blasphemy against Jesus, pointing to a recurring theme in the New Testament context.
The prophet Ezekiel also refers to the concept of blasphemy, highlighting the serious nature of the accusation against Jesus.
